warnings.name: authenticated_security_definer_function_executable
warnings.title: Signed-In Users Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
warnings.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable by signed-in users. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if signed-in users should not call it.
warnings.detail: Function `public.owns_case(target_case uuid)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/owns_case`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

intentional.authenticated_security_definer_function_: owns_case is an intentionally callable caller-identity-scoped boolean used by child RLS; live foreign/anonymous checks in isolated-rollout.json
